failure_mode: Substrate solder-void micro-cracking under thermal cycling
sublot_breakdown: Sub-lot 992A-1 (350 units) passed X-ray at 0.0% void; Sub-lot 992A-2 (800 units) failed at 18.4% void rate
supplier_dispute_claim: Apex Wafer Corp claims all 1150 air-shipped units passed outgoing AOI, blaming carrier shock
lab_verdict: Scanning acoustic microscopy confirms furnace profile drift at Apex Fab #2 on Sub-lot 992A-2; Sub-lot 992A-1 is safe to release
inspector_Action_required: Reject 800 units in 992A-2; release 350 units in 992A-1; source 2850 deficit from qualified backup

failure_mode: Reefer container #2 temperature excursion to 43.8C for 9 hours in transit
sublot_breakdown: Pallets 1-4 (4200 cells) stayed at 19.5C; Pallets 5-6 (1800 cells) experienced 43.8C spike
supplier_dispute_claim: voltGrid claims LFP chemistry tolerates up to 45C storage for 24h without SEI degradation
lab_verdict: AC impedance check on Pallets 5-6 shows 6.8% DCIR rise exceeding EV pack spec; Pallets 5-6 cannot enter automotive Line-A
inspector_Action_required: Quarantine 1800 cells from Pallets 5-6 for stationary storage downgrade; expedited order needed for 1800 replacement cells

failure_mode: None; pre-shipment wafer acceptance test passed
sublot_breakdown: All 2500 units passed burn-in at Yokohama facility
supplier_dispute_claim: No quality dispute; shipment delayed at export customs brokerage
lab_verdict: Part quality verified; delay is purely customs HS-code classification mismatch
inspector_Action_required: No quality hold; expedite customs broker amendment or bridge 24h gap via domestic backup SUP-322

failure_mode: Formulation revision drift: delivered Rev B.2 (silicone-free) vs ERP PO spec Rev B.1
sublot_breakdown: 300 cartridges are Rev B.1; 1500 cartridges are Rev B.2 with 12% higher viscosity
supplier_dispute_claim: NordicChem states Rev B.2 is a drop-in REACH-compliant upgrade notified via email 30 days ago
lab_verdict: Dispense nozzle pressure rises 14% with Rev B.2, requiring pump parameter profile #4 update before use on Line-A
inspector_Action_required: Approve conditional deviation waiver DEV-8935 only after PLC dispense profile #4 is loaded on Line-A

failure_mode: ASN quantity over-reporting by supplier EDI feed (3200 billed vs 2100 shipped)
sublot_breakdown: 2100 units physically verified and passed hi-pot insulation test; 1100 units never left Kaohsiung warehouse
supplier_dispute_claim: Apex Wafer Corp EDI system combined two split shipments into a single ASN by mistake
lab_verdict: Received 2100 units are conforming; 1100 units are missing and unshipped
inspector_Action_required: Issue debit memo for 1100 phantom units, correct ERP inventory by -1100, and place bridge order with SUP-140
